_comment: Verified selectors for common Foundry UI actions. Pseudo returns a KEY (never a raw selector); the client resolves it here, so the model cannot point at a hallucinated selector. The 'label' guides the model's choice. To add or fix a selector: open the console and run game.modules.get('cv-pseudo').api.captureSelector(), click the element, and paste the logged selector here. Remote Highlight auto-switches to the settings sidebar tab when spotlighting the data-app buttons.
_status: Verified live against Foundry v14.365 (dnd5e). Selectors return exactly one element each.

manage-modules.label: Manage Modules / Module Management button (enable or disable modules)

configure-settings.label: Game Settings / Configure Settings button (module and system options)

manage-players.label: Manage Players / User Management button (create player users)

invitation-links.label: Invitation Links button (the address/link players use to log in)

create-actor.label: Create Actor button (make a new character or NPC) in the Actors directory

create-journal.label: Create Entry button (make a new journal entry) in the Journal directory

create-scene.label: Create Scene button (make a new map) in the Scenes directory

create-card-stack.label: Create Card Stack button in the Cards directory

create-table.label: Create Table button (make a new roll table) in the Roll Tables directory

scene-tokens.label: Token Controls (left toolbar) — select/move tokens, targeting, ruler

scene-walls.label: Wall Controls (left toolbar) — draw walls and doors for vision/movement

scene-lighting.label: Lighting Controls (left toolbar) — place light sources

scene-drawings.label: Drawing Tools (left toolbar) — draw shapes and freehand on the scene

scene-tiles.label: Tile Controls (left toolbar) — place image tiles on the map

scene-sounds.label: Ambient Sound Controls (left toolbar) — place positional sounds

scene-regions.label: Region Controls (left toolbar) — define scene regions and behaviors

scene-notes.label: Journal Notes (left toolbar) — pin journal entries onto the map

macro-hotbar.label: Macro hotbar (bottom of screen) — slots for quick macros

players-list.label: Players list (bottom-left) — who is connected; right-click a name for user options

chat-input.label: Chat message box — type messages or roll commands like /roll 1d20
